quality_limits: The note corpus has incomplete authorship provenance; first-person evidence was content-classified and AI-marked notes were down-weighted.
Formal tracker prose includes AI-assisted material and informs process more strongly than natural voice.
Colleague mentions show dependency patterns more reliably than stable personality judgments.
Meeting artifacts were not read because the active identity lacked the additional artifact scopes.
The six-month window is a current operating model, not a permanent psychological profile.
excluded_sources: browser history: high privacy risk and low incremental signal
shell history: high secret exposure risk and low incremental signal
credential stores and keychains: out of scope
mail bodies: unnecessary after communication coverage converged
meeting transcripts and summaries: additional read scopes unavailable
